findings.text: follow-on: evidence_inputs states 'item (1) of f-ctta-sweep-durability-and-placement is met'. Item (1) covers two deliverables: the base-versus-head receipt comparator and the performance negative control, both previously run from /tmp and uncommitted. This node commits only the comparator. Coordinator writeback should record item (1) as partially met (comparator landed; performance negative control status still to be confirmed) rather than resolved.

follow-on: The new round-trip test builds a hand-constructed mesh via build_contour_tree and covers receipt_from_tree -> write_receipt_file -> --compare, but no committed test calls receipt_of, write_receipts or the --write CLI over a real Fixture carrier, so a regression in the fixture-driven serialization path would still pass the suite. Add one test that runs --write over a small fixture set and compares the written file to itself (and to a one-field mutation).

gate_arms_note: Both suite arms are present, completed and readable; the added-failure count is measured rather than an unmeasured zero.

item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed manifest is complete: status complete, commits c01f5f4c3 and b9711b2ca2, both changed paths listed, the green gate, the declared negative control with its exact failing ids, and both suite arms as armed JSON with revision, literal command, exit status, log path, completed and failure ids. item_verdicts.write_paths: Two commits f7f823c..b9711b2ca touch only benchmarks/contour_tree_brute_force.py and tests/test_contour_tree_receipt_comparator.py, both inside the granted repository paths, +308/-5. justifications.durability: The comparator, its tests and its repair are committed with bodied conventional commits; the gate, negative-control and both suite-arm logs sit on disk under the run directory with revisions and literal commands. The prior review's durability gap is substantially closed: the new test builds a real tree via build_contour_tree and round-trips it through receipt_from_tree, write_receipt_file and the --compare CLI, so a renamed tree attribute now fails the suite. Docked two because the fixture-driven serialization path (receipt_of / write_receipts / --write over a real Fixture carrier) is still uncovered by any committed test, and the negative control is a source mutation rather than an injectable knob.
justifications.evidence: Every load-bearing claim was reproduced independently in a private copy of the reviewed head tree at b9711b2ca (nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py sha256 23b8b792f9dcf68b48df2a59a76fe6c6fdb94417a6f5211fd75f9bf4559a2344, matching the reviewed worktree). Gate: 17 passed EXIT=0. Negative control (default field set mutated to omit edge_valid): 2 failed, 15 passed EXIT=1, failing ids exactly those the reviewed manifest declares. Independent end-to-end the committed suite does not carry: --write --fixtures certificate produced a 98467-byte receipts.json over four fixtures each carrying all seven fields; identical receipts printed 0 mismatches for all seven fields with exit 0, and flipping one edge_valid entry printed 'edge_valid: 1 mismatches' (all others 0) with exit 0->exit 1.
justifications.fit: Delivered as a benchmark mode (--write/--compare) matching the followup's 'benchmark mode' phrasing and reusing the existing Fixture/build_contour_tree machinery. The prior fit concern is resolved: the negative-control toggle is no longer read from the environment inside the production comparison path; compare_receipts takes its field set as an explicit argument and the CLI exposes only the full set, so a stray variable cannot turn a real mismatch into a pass.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every element of the requested deliverable is present and reproduces: seven-field comparison, one printed line per field with its mismatch count, nonzero exit on any mismatch, and the comparison field set is now an explicit argument with no process-wide switch. Docked two because the reviewed manifest's evidence_inputs still asserts item (1) of f-ctta-sweep-durability-and-placement 'is met' when only the comparator half of that item is delivered here.
justifications.scope_discipline: Changes are confined to the two granted repository paths, 308 added lines, no plan, sprint, index or out-of-scope file touched, and the reviewed worktree is clean. The review's own writes are the two review-record paths only; nothing was written into the reviewed tree.
